csv_project_name: Design for Ardmore Airport Runway 17/35 & S Connector Rehab
csv_scope_of_work: The Oklahoma Department of Aerospace & Aeronautics may be seeking a consultant to provide a Design for Ardmore Airport Runway 17/35 & S Connector Rehab. The existing runway pavement is exhibiting seasonal environmental distresses such as weathering, raveling, and longitudinal/transverse cracking. The pavement is at a point where it is more cost effective to rehabilitate than let it deteriorate until a point where reconstruction is required. Rehabilitation will include an overlay. This project will also address the non-standard connector taxiway at the south end.
